items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And another friend of mine, Eugene, he began to really play snare drum very well

ctx.x: And another friend of mine, Eugene, he began to really play snare drum very well, and like he lived close to me so we would always be together and he would show me things that I didn't understand. And so from that, after I left school, there was a friend of mine who was a dancer, and he asked -- he invited me, 'Come up to the club where we're dancing, and I would like you to see, you know, understand the different rhythms and things.'
